title: unified-rollouts: add stability guards, e2e tests, and observability for canary/shadow AB autorollback
author: Ava Thompson
description:
Motivation:
We have seen a few incidents where canary/AB/shadow rollouts briefly tripped high-error conditions before automated rollback triggered, leading to noisy alerts and slow recovery. This PR hardens the unified-rollouts controller with stability guards, extended metric windows, and end-to-end tests that exercise shadow/canary/AB flows. It also adds observability hooks and Prometheus metrics used by the rollback decision engine.

What this changes (summary):
- Introduces a stability guard that requires transient spikes to persist across a configurable evaluation window before counting towards rollback thresholds.
- Adds a decoupled metric smoothing layer (EWMA) and configurable multi-metric aggregation to reduce sensitivity to single-point noise.
- Extends the rollback decision logic to require agreement across user-visible and infra-facing metrics (error-rate, latency-p50/p95, model-match-rate).
- Adds a set of end-to-end integration tests that run in the perf-canary lab to simulate progressive canary, shadow probing, and AB traffic.
- Exposes new Prometheus metrics and tracing tags for rollout decisions to make debug/playback easier in the Console.
- Adds migration docs and a default-safe config so existing customers see no behavior change unless they opt in or operators upgrade rollout policies.

Checklist:
- [x] Stability guard implementation in controller
- [x] EWMA metric smoothing module
- [x] Multi-metric aggregation and decision rules
- [x] E2E tests for canary/shadow/AB paths
- [x] Metrics/tracing integration and dashboards
- [x] Migration notes in docs

High-level commit list:
- introduce stability guard and evaluation window
- add EWMA smoothing and aggregation helpers
- update rollback decision engine to evaluate multi-metric agreement
- add e2e tests and perf lab harness scripts
- add prometheus metrics + Console dashboard metadata
- docs: rollout migration notes and config examples

Files touched (high level):
- services/unified-rollouts/controller/decision_engine.go
- services/unified-rollouts/controller/stability_guard.go
- services/unified-rollouts/metrics/ewma.go
- services/unified-rollouts/tests/e2e/canary_shadow_ab_test.go
- observability/dashboards/rollouts.yaml
- docs/rollouts/migration.md

Notes on backward compatibility:
- Default policy values are conservative; operators will not see behavioral changes until they explicitly enable the new stability_guard or set shorter evaluation windows.
- Configs are additive; there is a compatibility shim for older rollout specs.

Related: ENG-1978 (reduce noisy rollbacks), ENG-2034 (rollout observability), SUP-9982 (support case documenting noisy autorollbacks).

review_conversation: Ravi Patel (reviewer): Can you clarify how the stability window interacts with the existing short-circuit for high-severity infra errors? I'm worried we might delay rollbacks for true incidents.

Ava Thompson (author): The short-circuit remains; stability guards only apply to metric-based rollback thresholds. We added an explicit fast-path for infra-level SLO breaches (see decision_engine.go:fastPathCheck).
Marisol Vega (reviewer): e2e tests look good but flaky on p95 in the perf lab. Suggest increasing mock latency variance to ensure determinism.
Ava Thompson (author): Updated the harness to use deterministic seeds and added a flakiness guard. Re-ran e2e, CI green.

release_notes:
- Added stability guard and evaluation window to reduce noisy autorollbacks.
- Introduced EWMA smoothing and multi-metric agreement for rollback decisions.
- New e2e tests for canary/shadow/AB flows and improved observability metrics.
Operators: default behavior is backward compatible; to opt into more aggressive stability settings see docs/rollouts/migration.md.
notes: This change was driven by multiple incident postmortems and support escalations (SUP-9982). The e2e lab was valuable to reproduce and verify mitigations before rollout.
back_compatibility_risks: Low: conservative defaults + compatibility shim. Risk if operators manually shorten evaluation windows.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for EWMA and stability guard. E2E tests run in perf-canary lab; observed flaky p95 fixed by deterministic harness seeds.
smoke_test_instructions: Run ci/workflows/rollouts-e2e.yml against perf-canary lab. See infra/perf-canary/harness/README for environment setup.
internal_notes: Follow-up: expose a rollout_policy.opt_in_beta flag to allow gradual customer opt-ins. Add an automated dashboard alert for stability_guard activations.
